events.outcome: Current CMLink UK promotion explicitly advertises GBP15/year for 365 days of number holding. 2026 community reports preserve material operational constraints: customer-service or plan-history eligibility may be required, and retention/one-time-plan expiry can be followed by a roughly 30-day no-plan closure window.

data.acquisitionSummary: CMLink UK currently offers UK mobile service on a local partner network and promotes physical SIM/eSIM options. The GBP15/year keep-number product is live, but 2026 community reports indicate that access to the retention plan may depend on customer-service handling or current/prior monthly or annual plan history.

keep.action: Use the current CMLink UK Keep UK Number plan. The provider advertises GBP15 for 365 days of number holding; community reports say plan eligibility/order handling and the post-expiry no-plan window must be checked with CMLink before relying on it.

data.chinaActivation: CMLink states UK-number retention in China and roaming support, but activation geography and workarounds are not normalized as a guaranteed remote-China activation path in this review.
data.kyc: Current reviewed materials do not establish a universal KYC-free path. Preserve account/plan eligibility and activation requirements as unresolved rather than inferring them.
data.payment: Current plan purchase/payment path depends on CMLink account and plan eligibility; community evidence indicates customer-service handling may be needed.
data.wifiCalling: Community users report Wi-Fi Calling as an operational workaround during mainland-China VoLTE roaming issues; provider-guaranteed China behavior was not established here.
data.roamingSms: CMLink advertises China roaming/number retention, but 2025-2026 community reports describe mainland-China outgoing call/SMS disruption and do not establish universal third-party OTP reception. Keep as evidence-scoped.
data.holdReason: GBP15/365-day retention product is live, but enrollment eligibility/customer-service path, post-expiry closure timing and mainland-China SMS/voice behavior remain material operational constraints.
data.tariffSummary: Current provider advertises GBP15/year for 365-day number holding; HOLD until eligibility/order and China-side operational behavior are fully reconciled.
guideSteps: Confirm current eligibility for the GBP15/year keep-number plan with CMLink.
Verify activation and mainland-China roaming/SMS behavior for the intended device before depending on the number.
Renew before expiry and do not rely on ordinary paid activity alone as a keep-number mechanism.
